en: Sepia-toned studio portrait of an elderly Eastern Orthodox cleric with a long white beard, wearing a dark cassock and a tall clerical hat (kamilavka/miter). He is seated, facing slightly to the side, with his hands resting on his lap and on a support. Around his neck hangs a large, ornate engolpion/pectoral medallion bearing a small religious image. The background is softly painted with a column and landscape, typical of early 20th‑century studio photography. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
